item.title: Morocco’s Hakimi named to FIFA’s Best XI
item.description: Morocco’s Achraf Hakimi has capped a sensational 2024/25 campaign by earning a place in FIFA’s Best Men’s XI of 2025, the only African player on the list. item.title: Airtel Africa partners with Starlink’s SpaceX
item.description: In a major connectivity push, Airtel Africa has announced a groundbreaking partnership with SpaceX to deploy Starlink’s direct-to-cell satellite technology across all 14 of its markets. item.title: African Development Bank raises record fund
item.description: The African Development Bank has secured a record $11 billion for its concessional financing window, marking the largest replenishment in the history of the African Development Fund.
